name: U.S. Reports, volumes 347–349 — CAP pilot
description: 2,142 historical case records from U.S. Reports volumes 347–349 in one searchable archive, supplied by the Caselaw Access Project. Includes case metadata, citation links across volumes, separately labeled opinions, footnotes, and original page references. This source selection is not a complete court term or current-law collection; OCR may contain errors.
